past.company_description: Tesla is accelerating the world’s transition to sustainable abundance. To achieve our mission, we're building a world powered by solar, enabled by battery storage and transported by electric vehicles. We’re committed to hiring and developing top talent from around the world for any given discipline. Headquartered in Texas, we operate six huge, vertically integrated factories across three continents. With over 100,000 employees, our teams take a first-principles approach to designing, building, selling and servicing our products in-house. Our world-class teams operate with a non-conventional philosophy of inter-disciplinary collaboration. Each member of the team is expected to challenge and to be challenged, to create, and to innovate. We’re tackling the world’s most difficult and important problems—and we wouldn’t succeed without our shared passion for making the world a better place.
past.description:
Lead engineer for Model X, Model 3, post-Model 3 next-generation low voltage electrical architectures and smart robotic systems for vehicle assembly.

Specified functional safety standards for autonomous vehicle systems and adapting electrical architecture designs to follow and exceed these specifications using concepts from ISO 26262

Created all-new electrical architecture using statistical analysis of data from multiple internal sources for Tesla Model 3 and next-generation platforms resulting in cost savings in excess of $550 per vehicle

Developed first electrical device information database at Tesla to generate progress reports for executive leadership and significantly improve accuracy of information transfer by further developing an automatic data export into the Capital wire harness design tool set

Implemented stereo vision system for Kuka 6-axis industrial robots for tolerance-aware path planning

Engineered system with computer vision-based navigation to robotically install a traditional wire harness into vehicle body parts
past.name: Tesla
past.title: Staff Electrical Engineer
